plan.title: SRC-BID-011 RFQ Bid at Price Cap

steps.note: Enable price-cap validation required by the case.
Every publishable create test needs a title.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one product for the bid sheet.
Invite the named Vendor A to the RFQ.
Publish the RFQ with no bids yet.
Verify the RFQ reached its live project page.
Open the published RFQ participant list to configure Vendor A's cap.
Set Vendor A's price cap to 100 before bidding.
Verify the saved cap is exactly 100.
Move to the separate Vendor A supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this live RFQ from Vendor A's event list.
Verify Procol accepted the bid in the vendor portal.
